item.text: The first test run found a timing issue in the new missing-root test: it checked whether the result channel was closed before the walker goroutine had finished. I’ll make that assertion wait for closure, then rerun the tests.
The scanner and utils tests now pass. I also checked the path handling: the walker uses slash-separated `fs.FS` paths, and `Scan` converts them back to the media folder’s OS paths.
